business_summary: Lubair Aviation Technology Co., Ltd. provides aviation material solutionsThe company offers aircraft parts, such as communication, landing gear, engine, flight control/navigation, hydraulic, cabin, lighting, structure, APU, parking apron, gallery bridge, and terminal; and repair workshop services. It also provides lubricating oil, seat belt, scouring pad, sheet material, fuse, decorative strip, marking pen, standard parts, surface treatment, glass mcro-ball material, test agent, deicing fluid, hook and loop fasteners, grinding, printer paper, wire, floor sealant, ground consumable and headset, light bulb, battery, plugs, silica gel, antifreeze, preservative, privacy film, pilot headset, honeycomb core, SERVICE, steel cable, insulation material, tool, interior laminator, consumable, adhesive tape and film, metallic material, nylon cable tie, PPE, coolant, grain, aluminum foil, and extinguishing agent. In addition, the company offers sandblasting material, other ground support equipment, other aviation chemicals and raw materials, other consumption products, cutting fluid, detergent, cleaning foam, grease, equipment and facilities, consumable, casing tubes, special lubricant, coating, fiber cloth, disinfectant, oxygen mask, hydraulic oil, fluorescence stip, pre-moisturize wiping paper, adhesive and sealants, and hook and loop fasteners, as well as interior consumed parts, raw materials, and PMA. It sells its products under the Run Xiaobei, LuHoPe, SAY MORE, Dr.CC, and AeroComm brands, as well as ExxonMobil, 3M, AkzoNobel, APLIX, BREYDEN, CLICK BOND, DUPONT, EURO-COMPOSITES, FEDERAL MOGUEL, GECurrent, HUNTSMAN, HUTCHINSON, H.B.Fuller, LANXESS, LONSEAL, Lufthansa, McGean, Permabond, ROYAL, Sabic, and TIME brands. Further, it provides aircraft tape and film product, exterior cleaning, deep cleaning, adhesive fastening support, polymer composite sheet solutions. Lubair Aviation Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
business_summary_ko: Lubair Aviation Technology Co., Ltd.는 항공 소재 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 통신, 랜딩 기어, 엔진, 비행 제어/항법, 유압, 객실, 조명, 구조물, APU, 주차 에이프런, 갤러리 브릿지 및 터미널과 같은 항공기 부품을 제공합니다. 수리 작업장 서비스. 또한 윤활유, 안전벨트, 수세미, 시트재, 퓨즈, 장식 스트립, 마킹 펜, 표준 부품, 표면 처리, 유리 마이크로볼 소재, 시험제, 제빙액, 후크 앤 루프 패스너, 연삭, 프린터 용지, 와이어, 바닥 실런트, 접지 소모품 및 헤드셋, 전구, 배터리, 플러그, 실리카겔, 부동액, 방부제, 프라이버시 필름, 파일럿 헤드셋, 허니컴 코어, SERVICE, 강철 케이블, 절연재, 도구, 인테리어를 제공합니다. 라미네이터, 소모품, 접착 테이프 및 필름, 금속 재료, 나일론 케이블 타이, PPE, 냉각수, 곡물, 알루미늄 호일 및 소화제. 또한 회사는 샌드블라스팅 재료, 기타 지상 지원 장비, 기타 항공 화학 물질 및 원자재, 기타 소비 제품, 절삭유, 세제, 청소 폼, 그리스, 장비 및 시설, 소모품, 케이싱 튜브, 특수 윤활제, 코팅을 제공합니다.
